Market Intelligence — Centre for Remanufacturing and Reuse

## Market intelligence

Core to the CRR has been our work developing and understanding the remanufacturing market across a large number of different products and countries.

Our remanufacturing Map showed the extent of remanufacturing activities throughout Europe and beyond, contact us to learn more.

This research has given us a unique overview of the remanufacturing industry in the UK and abroad. We have used this research to determine that the remanufacturing industry in the UK is worth nearly £5bn to the UK economy. Our studies are widely used as a reference source.
